t: Tanzania was created on 26 April 1964 by the union of mainland Tanganyika and the islands of Zanzibar.
Julius Nyerere’s Arusha Declaration of 1967 made it Africa’s best-known experiment in socialism, known as ujamaa.
It has had no successful coup or civil war, and Swahili gives it one of the strongest national identities in Africa.
dyk: Julius Nyerere translated Shakespeare’s Julius Caesar and The Merchant of Venice into Swahili, part of his effort to make Swahili a language of national culture.
ev: Tanganyika and Zanzibar unite on 26 April; the name Tanzania is adopted in October
The Arusha Declaration launches ujamaa socialism
Dodoma is designated the future capital
TANU and the Afro-Shirazi Party merge as Chama Cha Mapinduzi
Tanzanian forces capture Kampala and overthrow Idi Amin
Samia Suluhu Hassan becomes the first woman president

f.predecessor: Tanganyika and the People’s Republic of Zanzibar
